noise_floor_context: Theoretical noise floor: Simulated perfect model achieves RMSE ~2.81, MAE ~1.96, R^2 ~0.15 on pooled FPL player-GWs due to irreducible single-match variance (FPL Review benchmark; OpenFPL arXiv:2508.09992). Small weekly MAE deltas represent random outcome noise. Gameweek block bootstrapping is computed to assess genuine statistical significance without naive i.i.d. row assumptions.
